newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish minister cancels visit due to Iraq crisis.
newsitem.headline: Turkish minister cancels visit due to Iraq crisis.

text.p: Turkish Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller on Tuesday postponed her planned trip to Jordan because of the crisis in Iraq, the state-run Anatolian news agency said.
"Deputy prime minister and foreign minister Tansu Ciller has postponed her visit to Jordan due to recent incidents in Iraq," Anatolian said.

Anatolian said the decision was made after late-night meetings on Monday to review events in neighbouring Iraq, where the forces of President Saddam Hussein moved into the rebel Kurdish city of Arbil.
On Tuesday the United States said it had launched cruise missile attacks against Iraq in retaliation for Iraqi attacks on the Kurdish north.
